entities.name: PMID:27511272
observations: Grosberg et al., Journal of Medical Internet Research (2016), evaluated social health network use, disease knowledge, and Patient Activation Measure scores in a survey of Camoni users.

entities.name: Frequent network use and activation
observations: In a cross-sectional/retrospective survey of 277 Camoni users, frequency and duration of site visits correlated positively with chronic-disease knowledge and patient activation (P<.05); correlation coefficients were not reported in the abstract.
Among diabetes users, established users had higher PAM scores than new users (69.3 vs 62.8; P<.001). Observational results establish association, not causation.
